authorInstruction: The isolated image of him is the approved look. Adjust Book Three.

identity.face: Rounded warm orange cartoon face; no pronounced human nose, pointed chin, jawline or cheekbones.
identity.eyes: Two enormous vertical oval white eyes, black vertical oval pupils with small highlights; retain proportions in every expression.
identity.browsAndMouth: Simple curved black brows and expressive cartoon mouth. Adapt mood through brows and mouth without changing facial identity.
identity.flames: Thick painted flowing yellow, gold and orange flame tongues with a sweeping rising crest, strong dark outlines and shaded volume.
identity.anatomy: Floating head and flames only; no neck, shoulders, body, arms or legs.

avoid: Human/anime facial proportions, small eyes, sculpted nose or chin
Pale yellow human-looking skin replacing the orange face
Neon electrical webs, thin lightning filaments or a face carved from realistic fire
Using later chapter images or covers as an identity source in place of the isolated portrait
scope: All active Book Three appearances and cover, and all new Flaming Head art. Other characters and story action must remain consistent.
expressionRule: He may be concerned, alarmed or sad without losing the approved eye proportions, round orange face and thick painted flame silhouette.
